gen-megrim-gf-blinker: Sharp, angular, a little sci-fi: Megrim keeps every stroke to a measured thickness. Blinker does the everyday reading, with open letterforms and lowercase filling most of the line height.
gen-megrim-gf-fresca: Megrim's skyward x-height line sets the angular, futuristic tone, every stroke held to one measured width. Fresca keeps its counters connected to the outside, giving the whole thing a modern, clean feel.
gen-megrim-gf-gafata: Futuristic and angular, Megrim keeps every stroke to a single measured thickness, while Gafata sets wide-eyed lowercase under short stalks. Its strength is sharp drama up top, easy lowercase below.
gen-megrim-gf-gidole: Megrim's skyward x-height line makes it the showpiece, all angles and futurist attitude. Gidole is the steadier voice, with neon-tube consistency in every stroke and terminals held apart like open scissor blades.
gen-megrim-gf-heebo: Megrim has a pipe-cleaner look: angular strokes, futuristic, all at a measured thickness. Heebo keeps long text moving smoothly, its generous central band and open-ended curves never crowding the line.
gen-megrim-gf-hind-guntur: Sharp, angular, a bit sci-fi: Megrim sets the mood with measured strokes. And Hind Guntur grounds it on the page with stamped-metal lowercase and wide gaps between curve ends and stems.
gen-megrim-gf-hind-mysuru: Angular, futuristic, unmistakable: Megrim keeps every stroke measured, while Hind Mysuru packs its lowercase up near the ascender height. Text moves along easily, every lowercase a left slightly ajar.
gen-megrim-gf-hind-vadodara: Megrim's skyward x-height line and angular cut feel properly futuristic, built for display lettering. Hind Vadodara handles the running text, with spacious gaps in its rounded forms and a thickness that never shifts.
gen-megrim-gf-karla: Megrim's skyward x-height line sets the angular, futuristic tone, every stroke held to one measured width. Karla does the daily work, its wide-mouthed c and stocky middle band making text feel friendly.
gen-megrim-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri sits rounded and inviting under Megrim's angular, futuristic lettering. Kedebideri's real strength is a skyward x-height line, which gives its rounded letters plenty of presence beside Megrim's measured strokes.
